summary: Gated dual flag-setter wrapper. When both a1 (this object) is non-null and the low DWORD of the packed 64-bit value a2 is non-zero, calls FlagSetterWithGuard_3b36(a1, a2, SBYTE4(a2)) to set a flag/state from a2 using its sign-extended high byte as the guard value, then calls FlagSetterFloatStore(a1, a2, 0.4545499980449677) to store the constant loaded from dbl_5AF4C8 into a related field. Returns nothing.

operations.description: If a1 is null the function returns immediately without performing either flag-setting call.
If the low DWORD of a2 is zero the two flag-setting calls are skipped.
Call FlagSetterWithGuard_3b36(a1, a2, SBYTE4(a2)), passing a1, the packed 64-bit value a2 and the sign-extended high byte of a2 as the guard value.
Call FlagSetterFloatStore(a1, a2, 0.4545499980449677), the float constant loaded from dbl_5AF4C8 at global 0x005AF4C8.
